---
title: "Snakebite-Holoruminant-MetaG"
subtitle: "Module report: reference"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
geometry: margin=2cm
fontsize: 10pt
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("reference")

hosts <- ctx$features$hosts
host_table <- map_dfr(names(hosts), function(host) {
  fasta <- p("results", "reference", "hosts", paste0(host, ".fa.gz"))
  fai <- paste0(fasta, ".fai")
  numbers <- if (file.exists(fai)) {
    lengths <- read.delim(fai, header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "")[[2]]
    length_stats(lengths)
  } else {
    length_stats(numeric(0))
  }
  bind_cols(
    tibble(order = match(host, names(hosts)), host = host, configured = as.character(hosts[[host]]),
           bytes = if (file.exists(fasta)) file.size(fasta) else NA_real_),
    select(numbers, sequences = contigs, total_bp, longest, N50)
  )
})
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  if (nrow(host_table) == 0) {
    para("No host genomes are configured in `", features_file, "`, so reads aren't filtered for host DNA. This is usual for ",
         "environmental samples.")
  } else {
    para(
      "**", plural(nrow(host_table), "host genome"), "** configured, with ", fmt_bp(sum(host_table$total_bp, na.rm = TRUE)),
      " of sequence in total. The preprocess module removes reads of each of them, in this order: ",
      paste0("`", host_table$host, "`", collapse = ", "), "."
    )
  }
})
```

```{r hosts}
section("Host genomes", {
  if (nrow(host_table) > 0) {
    para("The order matters for the numbers, not for the result: a read that fits two hosts counts for the first of them. ",
         "The module recompresses each genome with bgzip, because `samtools faidx` needs that format.")
    show_table(
      host_table %>% transmute(
        Order = order, Host = host, Sequences = fmt_int(sequences), Length = fmt_bp(total_bp), Longest = fmt_bp(longest),
        N50 = fmt_bp(N50), `Size on disk` = fmt_bytes(bytes)
      ),
      "Host genomes, in the order of decontamination",
      "hosts",
      export = host_table
    )
    show_table(
      host_table %>% transmute(Host = host, `Configured file` = configured),
      "Where each host genome comes from",
      "host_sources"
    )
    if (nrow(host_table) > 1) {
      show_figure(
        host_table %>%
          mutate(host = factor(host, levels = rev(host))) %>%
          ggplot(aes(total_bp / 1e6, host)) +
          geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[1]]) +
          scale_x_log10() +
          labs(x = "Genome length (Mb, logarithmic scale)", y = NULL) +
          theme_report(),
        "host_lengths",
        "Length of the host genomes.",
        height = rows_height(nrow(host_table), 0.25)
      )
    }
  } else {
    para("There are no host genomes to report.")
  }
})
```

```{r databases}
section("Reference databases of this project", {
  para(
    "Other modules use these databases. For a paper, their names and folders tell you which release you used. ",
    "**Available** shows whether the path exists now."
  )
  flatten <- function(x, prefix = "") {
    imap(x, function(value, key) {
      name <- if (nzchar(prefix)) paste0(prefix, " / ", key) else key
      if (is.list(value)) flatten(value, name) else tibble(database = name, path = as.character(value))
    }) %>%
      list_rbind()
  }
  databases <- flatten(c(ctx$features$databases, list(magscot = ctx$features$magscot))) %>%
    mutate(available = file.exists(p(path)) | file.exists(path))
  show_table(
    databases %>% transmute(Database = database, Path = path, Available = ifelse(available, "yes", "no")),
    "Databases configured in features.yaml",
    "databases",
    export = databases,
    max_rows = 60
  )
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It describes what the rules of this module did.")
  if (nrow(host_table) > 0) {
    para(
      "> Host reference sequences (", paste(host_table$host, collapse = ", "), ") were recompressed with ", tv("bgzip (HTSlib)"),
      " and indexed with ", tv("SAMtools"), ". [Add the accession and release of each genome here.]"
    )
  } else {
    para("> No host reference sequences were used.")
  }
})
```

```{r end}
report_end(c(hosts = "Recompressed host genomes and their indexes"))
```
